banner.title: THE DSG PERSPECTIVE MAP PLATES CLOSED, R559: the pp. 124-127 child flips [x] in the third FLIP-ONLY round of the arc - zero pins, the census advances by the audit block alone. The hold on the child - until the doctrine its plates serve landed in full - is finally satisfied.
